newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gas blast kills at least five in Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: Gas blast kills at least five in Kazakhstan.

text.p: At least five people were killed on Wednesday when a gas canister exploded in an apartment block in Petropavlovsk, northern Kazakhstan. Another six people were missing.

Kazakh emergency services, cited by Russia's Interfax news agency, said the blast occurred early in the morning on the top floor of a five-storey block in the industrial city close to the Russian frontier.
A further 10 people were taken to hospital after the explosion, which destroyed the top two floors of the building, Interfax said. Rescue work was continuing.
Gas canisters are increasingly common in the former Soviet Union in places where regular supplies of natural gas have been cut off due to unpaid debts.
